motion.name: menu-static
motion.purpose: Menu-only television interference at up to 8fps; stopped during play and a fixed frame with reduced motion.

motion.name: hallway-switch
motion.purpose: Hallway switch feedback; transitions and press displacement are removed for reduced motion.

components.name: Menu action
components.description: Unboxed main-menu action; New Game starts Night 1 preserving unlocks, and Continue appears after one completed night.

components.name: Hallway switch plate
components.description: West/east plates order Door above Light, with explicit state readouts and visible keyboard shortcuts. Door closure is dark red; an active light is off-white. Zero power reads NO POWER and disables switches.
components.html: WEST HALL

components.name: Gameplay Help action
components.description: Unboxed in-game instructions trigger with a 44px minimum target and title-menu pointer on hover or keyboard focus.

components.name: Camera map
components.description: Fictional university academic-block floor plan, with lecture hall, library, lab, corridors, archives, stairwell, faculty lobby and campus security. Camera indices preserve gameplay routes.
components.html: OFFICE

components.name: Menu Settings
components.description: Bottom-left disclosure; its native checkbox panel opens upward. Sound starts on and subtitles off.
components.html:
Settings

Directional sound cues, even with sound off.
components.css: .ds-settings{position:relative;width:min(280px,100%);color:#e5e5df;font-family:"Courier New",monospace}.ds-settings summary{width:fit-content;min-height:44px;padding:14px 0;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;list-style:none;color:#bdbdb6}.ds-settings summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-settings summary:hover,.ds-settings[open] summary{color:#fff}.ds-settings-options{position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 8px);left:0;width:min(280px,calc(100vw - 64px));padding:16px 20px;background:#090909f5;border:1px solid #555}.ds-settings-options label{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;min-height:44px;gap:24px;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px}.ds-settings-options input{width:18px;height:18px;margin:0;accent-color:#deded5;cursor:pointer}.ds-settings-options p{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#b5b5ad}.ds-settings summary:focus-visible,.ds-settings input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #eee;outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: The user requested a more immersive, minimal horror game in the spirit of FNAF 1. The room fills the screen; the interface recedes into a clock, power readout, hallway controls, and camera toggle. The former decorative website framing and lime accents no longer lead the experience. University rooms use the user-selected UCA visual reference: an intact published black wordmark in the security office and blue-and-white Spanish room signs. Room geometry is fictional. The main menu places a three-line Courier title and unboxed actions on the left of the original dark Walter portrait, with bottom-left Settings opening upward. Continue appears after one completed night; native night selection appears after two. Canvas static stays beneath readable text.
keyCharacteristics: Sparse title menu and plain operational typography.
Persistent, readable gameplay states over the room.

rules.name: The Quiet Menu Rule
rules.body: Keep introduction prose and ordinary progress notes out of the main menu. Only a storage failure adds a progress status message.

dos: preserve clear active states and lime focus indicators.
keep camera interference beneath readable map and feed controls.
retain captions when audio is off.
donts: infer a new visual identity from the absence of a prior design document.
treat the current small text sizes as an accessibility standard.
